claim_ceiling: This cycle establishes exactly three things: (1) The evaluation infrastructure is intact — frozen digests, committed records, falsification matrix, and repeat-invariance all hold. The lane suite is a green, offline, stdlib-only validator. (2) The frozen retrieval benchmark reproduces its negative verdict — plain OpenCaseLaw search does not retrieve all frozen controlling authorities in FR/IT for three questions, produces duplicate alnum-core IDs in FR queries, and misses limiting-marker evidence for corporate-criminal-liability. These are real retrieval findings, not benchmark defects. (3) Independent of any slug-to-served-question mapping, the served bundle for de-kapitalverletzung fails to retrieve two core legal concepts of its own question (kapitalverletzung, uberwachungspflicht → 0 rows each), and the packet's admission record does not disclose this gap (admissible=true, warning_count=0). The v1 harness result (FAIL_PARITY_REGRESSION) does NOT establish a product-layer recall defect because no cell is subject-matched to the question the product serves (n_admissible_cells = 0). This cycle does NOT re-run live benchmarks, modify frozen specs, prove map utility, re-classify decisions, move label/geometry bars, lift DO-NOT-SERVE orders, certify admission, or change human_gate_ready.
